text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Senior Year summer training camp is finally starting.
As for Inari One—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Word is Oguri and the others are starting up in earnest after the summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta make the most of this training camp
to build up enough strength to beat those guys.
choice_data_list: This is gonna be a grueling training camp!
This is gonna be a tough training camp!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Get outta here! If I'm aimin' for the top,
that's a given!
If it'll make me stronger, I'd gladly run through hell!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The scorching training camp was about to begin...!
